main_text.l: cedens: uam Largitiones profusiores sunt quidam Despectus bonorum. Inde Rabbinis בזו Profundere, Prodigere facultates suas. Et apud Rab. פלג להון חולקין ונבזון ומתנן Distribuit illis portiones, largitiones & munera.

בזו Prædatus, Depræda-tus est, Diripuit, Ezech.29. verf.19. Præteritum irregulare, בזאו Diripiunt, Jesa.12.2. pro בזו. Niph. Præterit. ונבזו Et diripientur, Amos3.11. Infin. cum Futur. הבוז תבוז Diripiendo diripietur, Jesa.24.3. Pyh. Præter. ובזו Ut diripiantur, Jerem.50.37.

בַּז m. Præda, Jesa.10.6. Hinc לבז In prædam, Ezech.27.v.7. quod Masoretha notant legendum לבו per commutationem Gimel & Sajin. Sic alibi, גז pro זה. Rabbini id referunt ad commutationem literarum cabalisticarum אטבח, de qua vide Abbreviaturas nostras. Aff. בזם Prædam ejus, Ezech.29.9.
בזרת f. Præda, Direptio, Neh.4.4. Esth.9.10.

בזק m. Fulgur, Ezech.1.v.14. idem quod ברק, quod præcedit, commutatis ז & ר, ut Latinis in Honos & Honor. Est autem בזק Dispergere, apud Rabbinos, unde quidam reddunt, Fulgur dispergens, hoc est, vehementissimum.
בזר Sparsit, Dispersit, Dissipavit: Futur. יבזור Dispergęt, Dan.11.24. Pih. Præterit. בזר Dissipavit, Psal.68.31. Convenit cum פזר.
בחל Fastidivit, Aspernatus, Aversatus est: Præt. fœmin. בחלו Zach.11.v.8. Apud Rabbinos est Maturescere, Excrescere vel Coqui ad maturitatem: בוחל Fructus maturus.
בחן Probavit, Exploravit: Præterir. בחנני Probavit me, Job.23.10. Niph. Futur. יבחן Probetur, Job.34.36.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters are hard to read at this scan resolution; the Hebrew words are transcribed as far as legible and may contain small errors. The first Latin word "vam" is read as quam with the q not clearly visible, so it is written as uam. "funt" is read as sunt (long s). "Dispergęt" and the "ז" in "commutatis" are doubtful. The "E 3" signature is read from a small mark at the foot.
